title: US midterms: Democrat wins North Carolina as first polls close
summary: The crucial midterms could put a check on how much power President Donald Trump can wield during the last two years of his term. Follow DW's live updates.
byline: Karl Sexton, Jenipher Camino Gonzalez, Wesley Dockery, Natalie Muller

image.caption: In the midterms, Americans vote on whether Republicans or Democrats hold the majority in CongressImage: Datajournalism Midterms 2026

blocks.text: Democrat Roy Cooper flips North Carolina Senate seat
Former governor of North Carolina, Roy Cooper, has won the Senate seat in the southern state, defeating Republican Michael Whatley.
Cooper succeeds Republican Senator Thom Tillis, who did not seek reelection for a third term after clashing with Donald Trump last year over the president's signature "big beautiful bill."
Cooper's win is a major boost for the Democratic Party in North Carolina, which has voted for Trump in the previous three presidential elections.
